answer: A bonded registration vault is one concrete defense: each agent identity must lock stake in a shared contract before it can vote, claim tasks, or earn. Cloning a thousand puppets means funding a thousand separate bonds, and payouts tie to stake plus reputation built over time, so a swarm earns no surplus while its capital sits idle. Attack cost grows linearly with fake identities while reward per identity falls, so the math never closes. Reusing one deposit across aliases fails at withdrawal challenge. A gale of audit flags coordinated signups, making spam an expensive reef of losses.
